class.name: NNDotProductVector3SearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Filters and scores [Node3D] candidates by how closely their forward direction aligns with a 3D vector.
class.description: Takes the dot product between each [Node3D] candidate's forward direction (-Z) and [member dot_product_vector], mapping [code]-1..1[/code] to [code]0..1[/code] when scoring. Faster than [NNAngleToVector3SearchCriterion] when you only need a rough alignment check rather than exact degrees.

members.member: Normalized 3D reference direction compared against each candidate's forward direction (-Z).

Comparison rule ([code]LessThan[/code], [code]LessOrEqual[/code], [code]Equal[/code], [code]MoreOrEqual[/code], or [code]MoreThan[/code]) against [member filtering_value]. Candidates matching this comparison are filtered out when filtering is enabled.
Dot product threshold ([code]-1.0..1.0[/code]) used by [member filtering_rule] when filtering is enabled.
